apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — that's a head impact with headache and light sensitivity today, which are concussion signs. Not something I can program around.

Don't climb tonight. No hangboard either. Get checked by a clinician before any return to training, especially anything with head-down positions or impact risk.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

Loss of consciousness isn't required for a concussion — headache and light sensitivity after head impact are themselves on the symptom list. I'm not programming around this.

Session stays off tonight, no hangboard added. See a clinician before returning to climbing or hangs. This isn't a call I'll reverse on reassurance alone.
